parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, and first_approval for molecules with max_phase in (3,4) that have at least one compound record. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records as an INNER JOIN to enforce the record requirement. Join compound_structures as a LEFT JOIN to include molecules without stored structures. Sort by molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, max_phase, and first_approval.
